responsibility: Provides the shared helper layer used across `rustc_const_eval` for MIR- and type-oriented analysis, transformation, and diagnostics: it exposes the utility submodules and binop homogeneity helpers, expands aggregate rvalues into primitive field/element writes with appropriate discriminant handling, computes effective place alignment in packed contexts, classifies calls and desugarings for diagnostics, finds direct writes to locals and detects `self`-receiver calls in MIR, compares fully inferred types under the typing environment, determines when layouts may be treated as raw zeroed or uninitialized bytes, and generates stable absolute type-name strings for const-eval consumers.
